questions.prompt: Which covering kept the water warmest?

stimulus.title: Cup coverings
stimulus.body: Three cups each started with 100 mL of water at 60 degrees Celsius. The cups were identical except for their coverings. They stood in the same room for 10 minutes.

options.text: Foam
Cotton
Paper
All were equal

visuals.title: Cup coverings
visuals.altText: Results table for the cup coverings investigation. Column headings and measured results are provided in the table.

questions.explanation: Foam left the water at the highest temperature, closest to its starting temperature.
